scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on her account and requesting a potential refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Emily Baker and I'm 66. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Okay, I see you're asking about a charge. Can you tell me the exact date and the merchant name for that $76 transaction?
It was on the 14th, and the merchant is listed as 'Global Stream Services'.
Right, okay. I'm looking at your account now. Are you sure you didn't sign up for a subscription? A lot of people forget they have those.
I'm quite certain I haven't, no. I don't use any streaming services like that. Could you please check if it's a recurring charge or a one-time purchase?

I don't have the tools to see the subscription details. Look, I'm just going to escalate this to the fraud department because I don't want to deal with the dispute process right now. They'll call you eventually.
Oh, I see. Will I receive a confirmation number for this escalation, and is there anything else I need to do regarding the charge in the meantime?
I already told you, it's being escalated. You'll hear from them. Is there anything else?

escalation_reason: Agent lacked the competence or willingness to investigate subscription details and opted to offload the task to the fraud department.
